The Price Stabilization Corporation shall issue rules and
regulations regarding the placing of orders for said com-
modities as well as their handling and distribution to meet
the needs of the public.
This Order shall take effect as of the dates the Price
Stabilization Corporation was authorized by the President
of the Philippines in his letters of April 5 and May 11,
1951, to. import. the commodities herein listed without
quota allocation and in such quantities as may be found
Done in the City of Manila, this 3th day of June, in
